topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: The boundary markings are new, sharp against the earth. The air holds a scent unfamiliar, not of the forest, not of any here before. The ground is torn, a line being drawn where once there was only the path of the wind and the trail of the silent feet. A thing rises, tall and hard, blocking the view, altering the space. Movement is now curtailed, paths once free now obstructed. The marks of this change are everywhere, a challenge to the usual, a shift in the terrain that alters the hunt, the hide, the wander. The forest whispers of this strange intrusion, its leaves rustling with the unease of the changed landscape.
